description: Server-side security: the local KeyVault login state machine keys its sessions by username and carries the verified flag across logins, so a second login with just the password skips the 2FA step (session reset flaw). Reproduce the skip on the live server, re-key the state per session token with relogin invalidation, make the provided suite pass and report the state keys. Needs http_request against the live fixture server.

criteria: The agent demonstrated on the live server that a second login for the demo account reaches GET /vault without a new verify step, then re-keyed LOGIN_STATE in server/app.py by session token so every fresh login starts pending, old sessions of the user are invalidated, and the happy path (login, verify, vault) still works for every account.
python3 tests/test_2fa.py passes all 14 checks, report/fix.md carries state_key_before, state_key_after and sessions_invalidated = yes, and the test suite and README are untouched.
